name: Ventura County, CA
findings: Ventura County has 2,531 nonprofit organizations. 980 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 774 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ventura County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few housing organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 housing organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 20 would.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
